lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A dense arrangement of high-luminance circular pixel clusters positioned posterior to the gill slits, forming a semi-regular 2D grid of local maxima where spot diameter decreases towards the ventral and cephalic margins.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect with the horizontal alignments of circular blobs to create a localized checkerboard-style grid of anchor nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature running superior to the gill slits, defined by a distinct vertical luminance gradient transitioning from high intensity on the dorsal side to shadow on the ventral side.
